newsitem.title: UK: No easing in building soc takeover rules - report.
newsitem.headline: No easing in building soc takeover rules - report.

text.p: The government will not back down on plans to make building societies which convert to banks lose their protection from takeovers if they make a bid of their own, the Independent newspaper said on Monday.

The report quoted Treasury Minister Angela Knight as saying it would be "so discriminatory to allow these huge financial institutions to make hostile bids without those other institutions being able to protect themselves."

Knight was speaking before a meeting of members of the Alliance & Leicester building society on Monday at which they are set to approve the conversion of the society and its flotation as a bank next year.
The society has been critical of proposals to make the five-year protection against hostile bids conditional on not mounting takeovers for other financial institutions.
